chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Dāwūd ibn Sirḥān, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, “What do you say regarding the water of the bathhouse?” He said, “It is in the position of flowing water.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the Imam giving the ruling
key_terms.الْمَاءِ الْجَارِي: flowing water, a category with a known ruling in fiqh
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the position or legal status of
key_terms.مَاءِ الْحَمَّامِ: the water of the bathhouse, asked about in relation to ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on bathhouse water in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام concerning the water of the bathhouse. He states that it has the same ruling as flowing water, indicating its treatment within the laws of ritual purity.
